title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. In this article, we'll introduce three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, helping pregnant women supplement the necessary nutrients.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps prevent anemia, while folate supports the development of the nervous system and prevents birth defects. Vitamin C also plays a vital role in enhancing iron absorption.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken Bowl with Roasted Vegetables
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup roasted vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of heme iron, while roasted vegetables and orange provide vitamin C. This recipe is easy to cook and only takes 20 minutes to prepare.

## Recipe 2: Beef Stir-Fry Bowl with Spinach
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup spinach
* 1 lemon

Beef stir-fry is a good source of heme iron, while spinach and lemon provide vitamin C. This recipe is also easy to cook and only takes 25 minutes to prepare.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Bowl with Red Beans and Roasted Vegetables
* 100g cooked red beans
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup roasted vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange

Red beans are a good source of non-heme iron, while roasted vegetables and orange provide vitamin C. This recipe is easy to cook and only takes 20 minutes to prepare.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's essential to note food safety to avoid bacterial infections and other health issues. Ensure that all ingredients are cooked thoroughly and hot before eating. Additionally, avoid eating foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw or undercooked meat.

## Conclusion
The three recipes above are excellent choices for pregnant women who want to supplement iron and folate. Remember that providing enough nutrients is crucial to ensuring the health of both mother and baby. If you have any questions or concerns, please visit our [meal planner](/planner) or join our [prenatal nutrition category](/blog/prenatal-nutrition) to learn more.

## When to Seek Help
If you experience any of the following symptoms, seek help from your doctor:
* Anemia
* Birth defects
* Nervous system problems

faqs.question: Why are iron and folate important during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Iron and folate help prevent anemia and birth defects, and support the development of the fetus.

faqs.question: How can I increase iron absorption?
faqs.answer: Vitamin C helps increase iron absorption, so eat foods rich in vitamin C like oranges, lemons, and vegetables along with iron.

faqs.question: Are there any foods I should avoid during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Yes, avoid eating foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw or undercooked meat to prevent bacterial infections and other health issues.
